races.title: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post And Win' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: ATTIN and Jet of Stars both looked good when winning bumpers in the spring. Slight preference is for the former, as Jet of Stars must prove his well-being after suffering a health problem on his hurdles bow. Penalised winner Moon Reign is the only other realistic contender. ATTIN (FR) JET OF STARS (IRE) MOON REIGN

races.title: Coral 'Daily Rewards Shaker' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: JACK DEMPSEY caught the eye from a long way back when second at Carlisle 3 weeks ago and can go one better. Beat The Retreat also ran well on his comeback so is next best ahead of Athair Mor , who's often thereabouts. JACK DEMPSEY BEAT THE RETREAT (IRE) ATHAIR MOR (IRE)

races.title: 'Play Coral Racing-Super-Series For Free' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: BOSTON JURY looks as if he has revived for his new yard so he could be the answer with the return to this longer trip sure to suit. This does look competitive, though, with handicap debutant Allfor and course specialist The Jeweller's Pet completing the shortlist. BOSTON JURY (IRE) ALLFOR (IRE) THE JEWELLER'S PET (IRE)

races.title: Coral 'We're Here For It' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: None of these can be ruled out with slight preference for BRIDGE COURT , who is expected to leave his reappearance run well behind. No Regrets is back on a workable mark so is next best. BRIDGE COURT (IRE) NO REGRETS (IRE) GREEN ANGEL (IRE)

races.title: 'Join Coral-Racing-Club For Free' NH Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: DOUBLE ANNIE was a wide-margin winner on her second outing in Irish points and makes plenty of appeal now setting out under Rules for an in-form yard in an ordinary-looking race. Eillis is entitled to build on her debut promise back in May and is preferred to Pony Express for forecast purposes, with the latter having shown signs of temperament. DOUBLE ANNIE (IRE) EILLIS (IRE) PONY EXPRESS
